svg.title: Control, dependence and provider substitution
svg.desc: Comparison of operational control and dependency dimensions in platform integration and proposed cooperation across independent implementations. The strategic comparison is platform-governed integration versus participant-controlled cooperation across implementations. Both require meaning, evidence, policy, actions and lifecycle management, and both retain infrastructure and supply-chain dependencies. P1 is illustrated through documented Palantir capabilities, not a claim about all US Big Tech products. P2 is the proposed global cooperation model, building on European dataspaces and international contributions. Its differentiator is a requirement to demonstrate preserved behavior and credible substitution, not an assumed economic or security advantage.
